title: First Anduril YFQ-44A rolls off production line for US CCA program
summary: Anduril's Ohio facility has produced its first YFQ-44A, an unmanned, semi-autonomous aircraft. This marks a significant milestone for the U.S. Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) program, indicating progress in developing next-generation drone capabilities.

title: Pentagon calls for cheaper long-range strike weapons, with testing in just 3 months
summary: The Pentagon is seeking new long-range strike weapons that cost less than $250,000 each and can be ready for demonstration within three months. This initiative emphasizes rapid development and affordability for critical offensive capabilities.

title: HII Expands Distributed Shipbuilding to Amphibious Ships
summary: HII’s Ingalls Shipbuilding division has expanded its distributed shipbuilding strategy to include modular unit construction for the U.S. Navy’s amphibious transport dock program, starting with the Philadelphia (LPD 32). This builds on successful implementation in destroyer programs, aiming to increase throughput.

title: Poland’s A26 Submarine Deal: Details on Weapons Package, Interim Boat, and Delivery Schedule
summary: Poland has finalized an order with Saab for three A26-type (Blekinge-class) submarines, concluding the long-running Orka-submarine program. The deal includes details on the weapons package, undisclosed missile integration, a lease for HMS Södermanland as an interim boat, and delivery timelines starting in 2031.

title: Air Force eyes next-gen engine ‘integration’ by 2030
summary: The U.S. Air Force is targeting the integration of next-generation adaptive turbofan engine technologies by 2030. While no final decisions have been made, these advanced engines "could" be used on the forthcoming F-47 stealth fighter.

title: Ozlo’s Sleepbuds 2 build on Bose’s sleep earbud legacy
